_doc: Email-alert submit adapters. One file per provider in assets/providers/. 'tested' stays false until someone has run a real double opt-in signup end to end against a real account. A public build refuses to run with an untested adapter (set CS_UNTESTED_ADAPTER=1 only for local experiments; that build is stamped NOT FOR RELEASE). processor_suggestion is what each provider's public DPA said on 15 Nov 2026: copy it into data/site.json email_provider.processor only after checking it against the DPA you actually sign and the entity that contracts with a UK customer. tested:true is ignored (and a public build is blocked) unless 'evidence' is complete: date, tester, origin (the https site origin), cors:'ok', double_opt_in_confirmed:true, unsubscribe_confirmed:true, error_samples:[{case, provider_response, ui_message}]. processor transfer_basis uses keys: adequacy, uk_idta, uk_addendum, sccs, uk_us_data_bridge.

buttondown.label: Buttondown
buttondown.note: Buttondown's docs say not to fetch() embed-subscribe (subscribers may need to complete a CAPTCHA). The adapter submits a normal form POST into a new tab and never claims success itself.

processor_suggestion.transfer_basis_note: Buttondown DPA s.8: EU SCCs Module 2 + UK Addendum

mailerlite.label: MailerLite
mailerlite.note: Posts fields[email] to the embedded form's action URL and only reports success on a 2xx JSON response with success:true. Double opt-in is a per-form setting in MailerLite.

processor_suggestion.legal_name: TODO: MailerLite Limited (EEA/UK/Swiss customers; use this for a UK company) or MailerLite, Inc. (other countries). Confirm against the DPA you actually sign
processor_suggestion.country: TODO: EU (MailerLite Limited) or United States (MailerLite, Inc.)
processor_suggestion.transfer_basis_note: DPA s.13: SCCs + UK Addendum; MailerLite, Inc. also lists the EU-US DPF + UK Extension (would add uk_us_data_bridge). TODO: confirm contracting entity

brevo.label: Brevo
brevo.note: Posts EMAIL (+ email_address_check honeypot, locale) to the sign-up form's serve URL and only reports success on a 2xx JSON response with success:true. Turn on 'Double confirmation email' in the form settings.

processor_suggestion.country: France (hosting in France, Germany and Belgium)
processor_suggestion.transfer_basis_note: EU hosting; SCCs for sub-processors outside the EEA. TODO: confirm UK wording (may need uk_addendum or adequacy)
